Package com.csse3200.game.win

Class WinResult

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.win.WinResult
public final class WinResult extends Object
The outcome of one win check: the tier reached and the numbers behind it, so the win screen can show "Guardians defeated 8 of 8" and "Quests completed 2 of 3" and list what is still missing.

It is an immutable value. WinEvaluator is the only thing that builds one in the game; tests build them directly.

Invariants (checked in the constructor):

  • no count is negative
  • the mini bosses defeated cannot exceed the number required
  • the list of missing mini bosses has exactly required - defeated entries

  • Constructor Details

    • WinResult

      public WinResult(WinTier tier, boolean finalBossDefeated, int miniBossesDefeated, int miniBossesRequired, List<String> missingMiniBosses, int questsCompleted, int questsRequired)
      Parameters:
      tier - the tier reached; not null
      finalBossDefeated - whether Zeus in Level 3 was defeated
      miniBossesDefeated - required mini bosses defeated; 0 to miniBossesRequired
      miniBossesRequired - required mini bosses in total; not negative
      missingMiniBosses - labels of the required mini bosses not yet defeated, in roster order; a copy is stored; not null
      questsCompleted - quests completed; not negative
      questsRequired - quests needed for Legend; not negative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tier or the list is null, a count is negative, defeated exceeds required, or the list length is not required - defeated
